waves.name: Read-only batch extracts and setup
waves.rationale: Every unit here reads the masters or writes a dataset nothing else reads. It proves the toolchain, the KSDS access layer and the decimal type mapping where a mistake cannot reach a master.
waves.unblocks: The COBOL toolchain, the record layouts CVACT01Y, CVACT02Y, CVACT03Y and CVCUS01Y, the replacement for the assembler date routine COBDATFT, the GDG replacement that stores golden-master generations, and a CBEXPORT snapshot to seed the oracle for waves 2 to 4.

waves.name: Transaction report
waves.rationale: A must-not-break output that writes nothing to a master and can be diffed byte for byte. It is high-high by score. It sits here because it is the only high-high unit that changes no system of record.
waves.unblocks: The first byte-level comparison against a must-not-break output, and the SORT offset contract on the transaction layout (card number at 263, processing date at 305).

waves.name: Master and reference data refresh
waves.rationale: Delete, define and reload jobs with no COBOL. The port is a data-store load, and the check is a state diff of the loaded files. The account and card master refresh is a must-not-break item.
waves.unblocks: Masters in a known state to seed the wave 4 harness, and the load path the posting harness needs to reset between runs.

waves.name: Daily transaction posting
waves.rationale: The hardest must-not-break item. It is high-high, so it is strangled: the new posting runs in shadow beside the legacy run and is compared, and it does not replace it until the diff is clean.
waves.unblocks: Nothing later depends on it being ported, but the account master and transaction master are settled for waves 5 to 7.

waves.name: Online sign-on, menus and inquiry
waves.rationale: The sign-on and menu programs form one strongly connected component and every screen returns to them, so they move first among the online units. The inquiry screens are read only.
waves.unblocks: The screen layer, the menu tables COMEN02Y and COADM02Y, the authentication redesign, and the online launch of the transaction report.

waves.name: Online maintenance and payment
waves.rationale: These screens write the masters. Batch posting must already be settled so there is one writer model for the account and transaction masters.
waves.unblocks: Retirement of the CICS file close and open jobs, and one lock and id-generation scheme for all writers.

waves.name: Month-end interest and statements
waves.rationale: The hardest code and the paths that only run at month end. They go last among the core waves and are strangled behind a facade.
waves.unblocks: Closes the batch estate. The full-batch script and the monthly Control-M folder can be retired.

waves.name: Authorization (IMS, DB2, MQ) and transaction-type (DB2) modules
waves.rationale: Optional modules on IMS, DB2 and MQ, which this plugin does not analyze. They stay last, and their sequence is a guess until an IMS and DB2 specialist reviews them.
waves.unblocks: Nothing in the core depends on them, except that COPAUA0C reads the account balance that wave 4 posts.
